children: ICICI Securities's research report on Cera Sanitaryware

For Q2FY27, Cera Sanitaryware (CRS) reported strong revenue growth of 27.4% YoY, with faucetware/sanitaryware growing ~38%/24% YoY. OPM dipped 203bps YoY to 12.2% (+202bps QoQ) due to RM headwinds. Management stated that retail segment’s demand improved, while the project segment remained healthy. CRS has maintained its revenue growth guidance of 18–20% and 13–14% OPM for FY27. We expect CRS to continue reporting strong revenue growth due to volume traction and partly due to price hikes. OPM is expected to improve as RM inflation is passed on and price hikes in OEMs (~40% of revenues) possibly start from Q3. Maintain BUY, with an unchanged Sep’27E TP of INR 7,578.

Maintain BUY due to reasonable valuations and an improving outlook on operational performance, with an unchanged Sep’27E TP of INR 7,578, set at an unchanged one-year forward PER of 32x (a ~15% discount to its 10-year average 1-year forward PER).
